output:
To: Bethan Rees
Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!

Beth,

Just replying to you, not getting into it on the group email. I've just landed off a Lagos so bear with me if this comes out a bit muddled.

Will you have another think about coming, even just for Saturday? You don't have to do Friday at the cottage or the paddleboarding. Get the train from Cardiff Central, about two and a half hours ish, and I'll pick you up at Tenby station. You only need to be there for 6, meal's at 7.30, and you can kip in with me afterwards. I've got the twin room.

I'm not saying you should pretend everything's fine with Lowri. I know things were said on both sides at her 40th in November, and her reply this morning probably hasn't helped. I do wonder if she's sorry and just doesn't know how to climb down. You're both capable of being a bit stubborn, mind. But you don't have to sort all that out before you can come and be there for Nia.

She rang me crying last week asking if you were still coming. As far as I know she hasn't seen your message yet. I haven't forgotten you sitting with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019, and I know she hasn't either. You're not just another person making up the numbers to her.

You'll be there doing your reading at Margam on 17th April, but I think you'd be sad to have missed this bit with her too. She'll really miss you if you're not there.

I swapped Orlando with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, lost a night stop I really wanted as well! Not saying that to make you feel bad, just that I was looking forward to us all having a laugh together.

Hang on before sending Lowri any money. Let's work out what you're doing first.

Just Saturday, Beth? I'll collect you, we'll get ready together and you can stick with me.

Siân xx
